canonical_statement: Every semistable elliptic curve over the rational numbers is modular.
domain_and_universes: An elliptic curve E over Q; the eventual Lean universes and object model are not frozen at intake.
quantifiers: E : elliptic curve over the rational numbers

definition_boundaries.semistable: Good or multiplicative reduction at every prime; exact Lean predicate remains to be selected and checked.
definition_boundaries.modular: The elliptic curve is associated with a weight-two modular eigenform (equivalently, its L-function agrees with that of such a form); exact level and representation formulation remain to be frozen.
definition_boundaries.not_claimed: This intake does not broaden the result to all elliptic curves over Q and does not substitute a generic modularity-lifting schema for the published root theorem.

alternate_encodings.target: the p-adic Galois representation attached to E satisfies a modularity-lifting theorem
alternate_encodings.relationship: principal proof architecture used for the root, not definitionally the root statement

alternate_encodings.target: a weight-two newform has the same L-series as E

excluded_degenerate_cases: Singular Weierstrass models are not elliptic curves. Additive-reduction curves are outside this semistable theorem unless a later checked transport proves applicability.

tcb_profile: Lean 4 kernel with a pinned mathlib closure; exact versions and imported declarations remain open
